title: Durable Execution Integrations
summary: This module provides integrations for AI agents and toolsets with durable execution frameworks like DBOS, Prefect, and Temporal. It enables agents to run reliably by offloading operations to these systems' workflows and activities.

nodes.label: DBOS Agent Wrapper
nodes.title: DBOSAgent
nodes.description: Wraps an AI agent to enable durable execution via DBOS workflows, offloading model requests and tool calls to DBOS steps.

nodes.label: Prefect Agent Wrapper
nodes.title: PrefectAgent
nodes.description: Wraps an AI agent for durable execution using Prefect flows, offloading model requests and tool calls to Prefect tasks.

nodes.label: Temporal Agent Wrapper
nodes.title: TemporalAgent
nodes.description: Wraps an AI agent for durable execution with Temporal workflows, offloading model requests and tool calls to Temporal activities.

nodes.label: DBOS MCP Toolset Base
nodes.title: DBOSMCPToolsetBase
nodes.description: Abstract base for integrating Multi-Component Platform (MCP) toolsets with DBOS, converting tool operations into DBOS steps.

nodes.label: Prefect Agent Cache Policy
nodes.title: PrefectAgentInputs
nodes.description: A Prefect cache policy for PrefectAgent inputs, ensuring consistent cache keys by filtering volatile run-specific data.

nodes.label: Prefect Toolset Adapter
nodes.title: prefectify_toolset
nodes.description: Function to adapt various toolsets for Prefect, wrapping them to execute operations as Prefect tasks.

nodes.label: Temporal MCP Toolset Base
nodes.title: TemporalMCPToolsetBase
nodes.description: Abstract base for integrating Multi-Component Platform (MCP) toolsets with Temporal, converting tool operations into Temporal activities.

nodes.label: Temporal Run Context
nodes.title: TemporalRunContext
nodes.description: Specialized RunContext for Temporal, handling serialization and deserialization of agent run context for Temporal activities.

nodes.label: Temporal Toolset Adapter
nodes.title: temporalize_toolset
nodes.description: Function to adapt various toolsets for Temporal, wrapping them to execute operations as Temporal activities.

nodes.label: Logfire Instrumentation Setup
nodes.title: _default_setup_logfire
nodes.description: Configures Logfire for observability within Temporal workflows, instrumenting Pydantic AI components.

nodes.label: Base AI Agent
nodes.title: AbstractAgent
nodes.description: Represents the core AI agent functionality that is being wrapped by durable execution integrations.

nodes.label: Base Toolset Interface
nodes.title: AbstractToolset
nodes.description: Defines the interface for collections of tools used by AI agents, which are adapted for durable execution.

nodes.label: DBOS Framework
nodes.title: DBOS
nodes.description: The DBOS durable execution framework, providing reliable workflow and step execution.

nodes.label: Prefect Framework
nodes.title: Prefect
nodes.description: The Prefect durable execution framework, orchestrating data pipelines and workflows as flows and tasks.

nodes.label: Temporal Framework
nodes.title: Temporal
nodes.description: The Temporal durable execution framework, enabling fault-tolerant and long-running workflows and activities.

nodes.label: Logfire Observability
nodes.title: Logfire
nodes.description: An observability tool used for logging and tracing, integrated for monitoring durable executions.
